svg.aria-label: I'm a Platform / DevOps Engineer with a First Class BSc in Computer Science from the University of Southampton. I work across AWS and Oracle Cloud, from serverless deployments to migrating on-prem databases into the cloud. I build things that help me and might be helpful to others.
svg.text: I'm a Platform / DevOps Engineer with a First Class BSc in Computer Science from the University of Southampton.
I work across AWS and Oracle Cloud, from serverless deployments to migrating on-prem databases into the cloud.
I build things that help me and might be helpful to others.
